title: Routines
subtitle: Manage skills, commands, and MCP tools that enhance your AI workflow.
commandsDesc: User-level slash commands that expand into prompt templates. Type /commandName in the chat input.
commandRunBashFirstDesc: When enabled, using this command runs the Bash command below via the /bash flow before sending the prompt to AI. The Bash result is included in the same AI turn context.
commandBashCommandPlaceholder: e.g. git status --short. Supports {{input}} and parameter placeholders.
globalSkillsDesc: Skills available to all projects. Scanned from ~/.narrafork/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, ~/.agents/skills/.
projectSkillsDesc: Skills scoped to a specific project. Managed in the project's git repository.
mcpToolsDesc: Model Context Protocol tools available to AI narrators.
noProjectSkills: No skills found for this project.
noProjectSelected: Select a project to view its skills.
noGlobalSkills: No global skills found. Create one to get started.
skillDescriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of what this skill provides
skillContentPlaceholder: Skill instructions, examples, and domain-specific knowledge...
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete skill "{{name}}"?
mcpServersDesc: Configure external MCP servers to provide additional tools to AI narrators.
mcpNoServers: No MCP servers configured. Add one to get started.
mcpImportDesc: Paste a JSON config from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, or any compatible format. Single server configs are also supported.
mcpDefaultBehaviorDesc: Default permission behavior for all tools from this server.
optionalToolsDesc: Optional agent tools that can be loaded into a narrator session via /load command. Enable them here to make them available by default.
globalPromptDesc: Global instructions file injected into every narrator's system prompt. Loaded from ~/.agents/AGENT.md (preferred) or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.
globalPromptEmpty: No global prompt file found. Save to create one.
globalPromptPlaceholder: Enter global instructions for all narrators...
defaultSystemPromptDesc: The default system prompt for all narrators. When a narrator is created without a custom system prompt, it uses this as the base prompt. Changes take effect on narrator restart.
defaultSystemPromptPlaceholder: Enter the default system prompt for all narrators...
customSubagentsDesc: Define custom subagent types with specialized prompts and tool permissions. Custom types can be used alongside built-in types (explore, plan, general).
noCustomSubagents: No custom subagents defined. Create one to get started.
subagentDescriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of what this subagent specializes in
subagentDefaultModelPlaceholder: Leave empty to inherit from parent narrator
deleteSubagentConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete custom subagent "{{name}}"?
toolPermissionsDesc: View built-in and MCP tool permission categories. Manage command whitelist/blacklist rules for Bash.
tpBuiltinToolsDesc: Core tools available to AI narrators. Permission category determines behavior under different permission modes.
tpMcpToolsDesc: Tools provided by connected MCP servers.
tpCommandWhitelistDesc: Regex patterns for commands that are auto-allowed. Matched commands skip user approval.
tpCommandBlacklistDesc: Regex patterns for commands that are auto-denied. Takes priority over whitelist.
tpDenyPromptPlaceholder: Optional message shown when command is blocked
tpToolDescBash: Execute shell commands in the working directory.
tpToolDescRead: Read file contents from the filesystem.
tpToolDescWrite: Write content to a file, creating or overwriting it.
tpToolDescEdit: Perform exact string replacements in files.
tpToolDescGlob: Fast file pattern matching using glob patterns.
tpToolDescGrep: Search file contents using regex patterns.
tpToolDescWebSearch: Search the web for current information.
tpToolDescWebFetch: Fetch and extract content from web page URLs.
tpToolDescAgent: Launch a subagent to handle isolated tasks.
tpToolDescEnterPlanMode: Enter plan mode for implementation planning.
tpToolDescExitPlanMode: Exit plan mode and submit plan for approval.
tpToolDescTaskCreate: Create or update the todo list for the session.
tpToolDescAskUserQuestion: Ask the user a question during execution.
tpToolDescSkill: Invoke a skill within the conversation.
tpToolDescShareFile: Share a file by generating a temporary download link.
tpToolDescTerminal: Interactive terminal tool for long-running processes.
tpToolDescRecall: Search past conversations for relevant context.
tpWfAllowAllDesc: When enabled, all WebFetch requests are auto-allowed without user approval.
tpWfWhitelistDesc: URL keywords that are auto-allowed. If the URL contains any of these keywords, it skips user approval.
tpWfBlacklistDesc: URL keywords that are auto-denied. Takes priority over whitelist.
hooksDesc: Event hooks that run shell commands, HTTP webhooks, or LLM prompts at key lifecycle points (e.g. before/after tool execution).
noHooks: No hooks configured. Create one to get started.
hookDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this hook?
